name: myka-quad-erp
description: Myka Quad mini ERP — React front end (source/) + API on Vercel (api/, server/) + Supabase Postgres (db/)

scripts.build:vercel: npm test && cd source && npx --no-install tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && npx --no-install parcel build index.html --dist-dir dist --no-source-maps && mkdir -p ../_site && npx --no-install html-inline dist/index.html > ../_site/index.html && cp ../config.js ../_site/config.js
